U na le Mothopi {player_id} ({piece}). Mothopi wa gae ke ({opp}). Kenya tsoelo joaloka '[b1 c3]' (ho tloha → ho ea). Dipono tsotlhe di tsamaea joaloka dikhoasi tsa chess.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.
